subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should unconfigured memory search gain a default periodic sync fallback for watcher outages, or should interval sync remain opt-in while the issue is handled through docs/doctor/operator guidance?
rationale: Current main still has the source-level stale-index gap, but enabling interval sync by default changes background work and provider/indexing behavior for existing users.

options.title: Land a scoped default fallback
options.body: Accept a default periodic fallback after the open PR scopes dirty marking correctly and proves fresh-install plus upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep interval sync opt-in
options.body: Preserve the current `0` default and handle the issue with docs, doctor guidance, or an explicit setup recommendation.

options.title: Ask for live outage proof first
options.body: Hold the default decision until maintainers see a live long-running gateway reproduction or equivalent Crabbox proof.

recommendation.title: Land a scoped default fallback
recommendation.body: Accept a default periodic fallback after the open PR scopes dirty marking correctly and proves fresh-install plus upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory stale-index merger and memory config/docs contributor with the closest current-main history on the affected behavior.
